record.question: Mutism, negativism, waxy flexibility, bizarre posture and stupor are charac-teristics of:
record.explanation: Answer C: Catatonic schizophrenia. The listed mutism, negativism, waxy flexibility, posturing, and stupor are catatonic signs. “Catatonic schizophrenia” is a historical subtype label; DSM-5/ICD-11 treat catatonia as a syndrome/specifier rather than a schizophrenia subtype. Reference: https://www.psychiatry.org/psychiatrists/practice/dsm; https://icd.who.int/browse/2025-01/mms/en. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
